answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in quill, expire in whisper, and vine lists each expiry. An farming party running 52 aliases thus needs 43 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2503 identities would post 2315 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
